_meta.purpose: Region-awareness for the language resolver (SPEC-3.2 §5, region refinement / D-69 lifted). Maps a country + geocoded region/state NAME to the language(s) spoken there BEYOND the national official set — so a trip to Bengaluru surfaces Kannada, Barcelona surfaces Catalan, etc. Keyed by ISO-2 country → lower-cased region name (as the Photon geocode returns it) → ISO-639-1/3 language codes. National languages are subtracted at resolve time, so listing a national language here is harmless. Curated, extend freely; a region not listed simply yields no regional finding.
_meta.source: Official/scheduled regional languages by administrative subdivision (Wikipedia constitutional/statutory language lists); human-curated.
